project: Wuxia Life P70 Selected Next Route Design-First Contract
description: Turn the single route selected by P69 into a bounded design-first contract that fixes prerequisite truth, bridge shape choice, bridge contract, and P71 proof expectations before any runtime implementation begins.

userStories.title: Audit selected route prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the selected route so P70 starts from real gates, flags, expressions, and tests rather than assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the selected route's relevant origins, flags, gates, existing expressions, and existing tests
State what already exists before the bridge and what is still missing
Save docs/test-reports/p70-selected-route-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Prerequisite audit complete — jianghu_renown_sage has strong foundation (composite gate + ally_network flag + P32 short-chain proof + tavern_hand seed); gap is playable bridge + post-bridge spine + expression.

userStories.title: Lock P70 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P70 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P70 to gap audit, option comparison, bridge contract, and proof-shape planning
Define allowed layers: documentation, contracts, and targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, new frameworks, and bulk content waves
Save docs/test-reports/p70-selected-route-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract complete — 5 allowed layers (audit / comparison / contract / validation-shape / closure), 7 forbidden expansions, 6 boundary guards, quality-first priority order preserved.

userStories.title: Compare candidate bridge shapes inside the selected route
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded bridge-shape options for the selected route so P70 chooses the smallest viable entry path before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least two bridge-shape directions for the selected route
State one recommended bridge shape and one rejected direction
Ensure the recommendation matches quality-first and small-step implementation standards
Write the conclusion into the P70 comparison artifact
userStories.notes: Comparison complete — 2 candidates evaluated. Recommended: Ally-Network Midlife Bridge (Candidate A, tavern_hand + ally_network, single seed, low risk, proven pattern). Rejected/deferred: Mentor-Bond Martial Seed Bridge (Candidate B, zero existing infrastructure, large scope, poor small-step iterability).

userStories.title: Define the selected route bridge contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit bridge contract so P71 knows exactly what flags, gates, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the bridge checkpoint, required flags, and target gate acceptance conditions
Define at least two bridge-specific player-facing signals
State how the bridge differs from the generic path for that destination
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Bridge contract complete — ally-network midlife bridge from tavern_hand to jianghu_renown_sage. Checkpoint: tavern_renown_bridge_crossed + route_renown_committed. 3 player-facing signals (currentGoal, lifeMemory, summary). Tavern_hand identity preserved — renown grows from network/reputation, not martial skill. Mutual exclusivity with merchant bridge via ordinary_tavern_midlife_done.

userStories.title: Define P71 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P71 validation shape fixed in advance so playable bridge work is judged against explicit proof and regression expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: State which chain nodes the targeted proof must show
State the minimum regression assertions P71 must cover
State what exact evidence counts as a closed bridge
Do not require full lifetime exhaust

userStories.title: Produce P70 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the selected route's design-first contract and hands off a bounded implementation target to P71.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p70-selected-next-route-design-closure-report.md
Summarize the prerequisite audit, scope contract, bridge-shape comparison, bridge contract, and validation shape
State the boundary between P70 and P71
List larger route-expansion items that remain deferred
